scripts.start: pnpm --filter @wisp/protocol build && pnpm --filter @wisp/agent build && node apps/bridge/src/main.ts
scripts.agent: pnpm --filter @wisp/protocol build && pnpm --filter @wisp/agent build && pnpm --filter @wisp/agent dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @wisp/protocol build && pnpm --filter @wisp/agent build && pnpm --filter @wisp/desktop build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @wisp/protocol build && pnpm --filter @wisp/agent build && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @wisp/protocol build && pnpm --filter @wisp/agent build && vitest run
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm --filter @wisp/protocol build && pnpm --filter @wisp/agent build && node scripts/build-desktop.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --write && stylua --verify addon tests && prettier --plugin prettier-plugin-svelte --write "apps/desktop/src/**/*.{svelte,css,html}"
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check && stylua --check addon tests && prettier --plugin prettier-plugin-svelte --check "apps/desktop/src/**/*.{svelte,css,html}"
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings apps packages scripts tests addon/tests vitest.config.ts
scripts.stage:desktop: pnpm --filter @wisp/protocol build && pnpm --filter @wisp/agent build && node scripts/stage-desktop.ts
